title: PixlAudio Cloud Studio job result (pixl.cloudstudio.result v1)
description: Written to out/<jobKey>/manifest.json (last, after every output) and returned as the RunPod job output for op process. On status error the RunPod job itself is FAILED with the string "<CODE>: <message>"; the manifest in storage carries the details. Unknown fields must be ignored.

code.description: Known v1 codes: BAD_SCHEMA, UNSUPPORTED_VERSION, BAD_OP, BAD_URL, INPUT_TOO_LARGE, INPUT_MISMATCH, INPUT_MISSING, DOWNLOAD_FAILED, TOO_LONG, UNSUPPORTED_FORMAT, DECODE_FAILED, GPU_OOM, DEADLINE, UPLOAD_FAILED, POISONED, INTERNAL. Treat any other code as INTERNAL.

message.description: Redacted: never contains URLs, signatures or lyrics.

warnings.description: Free text for people, plus the machine-readable token "duplicate" (the guard found a finished manifest and returned it without working).

stems6.description: Worker 1.1.0 and later: the six-stem separation behind the spatial task (open-cascade-6).

restorer.description: Worker 1.1.0 and later: the restoration model, when it ran.

models.description: The model ids this job actually used (null when a stage did not run).

decodedSamples.description: Frames per channel after decoding at sampleRate (edit lists honoured).

sha256.description: The verified input's sha256 (= audio.sha256). The guard only short-circuits a duplicate job whose manifest names the same input.

input.description: null when the job failed before the input was decoded.

outputs.description: Keys are the output slots that were delivered (instrumental, vocals, drums, bass, other; and for the library tasks sp-<profile> and enhanced, whose key is the lib/ key, also when the file was already in the library). Empty on error.

library.description: Worker 1.1.0 and later. What became of the shared-library outputs of a job with the spatial or enhance task; null for any other job and on error. Download each ok or exists output from its lib/ key (outputs has it) and never delete it: other devices use it.

renders.description: Spatial profile id -> state, for every render the job asked for.

enhanced.description: null when the job had no enhance task. not_needed: nothing was restored, so there is no file (restore.reason says why); the library's enhanced.json records that.

restore.description: What happened to the song's highs in this job. null when the job did not analyse the song (everything it asked for was already in the library).

reason.description: Why it was not applied; null when it was.

cutoffHz.description: Where the song's spectrum ends (about 16000 for a band-limited stream, 20000 or the Nyquist frequency for a full one).

stemMode.description: How the renders made by this job were rendered: from six stems, from four (the fallback separator), or from the mix alone. null when it rendered nothing.

offsetMs.description: Global shift the worker applied to the sent line times (0 when none).

coldStartMs.description: Model load time on the first job of a process, 0 afterwards.

restoreMs.description: Worker 1.1.0 and later, like stems6Ms and renderMs; 0 when unused. The spectrum analysis and, when it ran, the restoration.

samples.description: Frames per channel the worker encoded; equals input.decodedSamples.
